description: This file defines an abstract class 'RelationalGroupedDataset' in Apache Spark's SQL module, providing methods for aggregations, grouping, and pivot operations on DataFrames, including Scala and Java-specific variants.

classes.name: RelationalGroupedDataset
classes.description: An abstract class providing aggregation and pivot methods for grouped DataFrames in Spark SQL.

methods.name: as
methods.description: Returns a KeyValueGroupedDataset with specified key and value encoders.

methods.name: agg
methods.description: Computes aggregations based on column names and methods, or a map of column to method, with Scala and Java variants.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of rows in each group.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Calculates the average of specified numeric columns for each group.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Calculates the maximum of specified numeric columns for each group.

methods.name: avg
methods.description: Alias for mean, computes average of numeric columns.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Calculates the minimum of specified numeric columns for each group.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of specified numeric columns for each group.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Performs pivot operation on a column with variants accepting column name or Column object, with optional list of values.
